title: Rebase the search quality set on the current plan
description: The search quality check in bench/ measures how well keyword, semantic and hybrid search find tickets. Its question set points at tickets of the first plan (PM-12, PM-58 ...), which was reset on 2026-11-08, so the check cannot run any more and the threshold for likely overlap in heist similar cannot be re-measured. Give the check its own fixture plan so it does not depend on this repository's tickets, then compare the plain z-score of heist similar with the robust strength used by the create hint.
why: bench/search-eval.json points at PM tickets that were removed when the plan was reset, so the calibration cannot be repeated.

acceptance.text: search-eval.json refers to tickets that exist or carries its own fixture
OVERLAP_Z comment names how it was calibrated
likelyOverlap in heist similar is compared with the robust strength on real tickets

todos.text: Add a fixture plan to bench/ (tickets with titles and descriptions, including known duplicates and related groups)
Point search-eval.json at the fixture keys
Run the check with the real model and record the numbers in implementation-decisions.md
Decide from the numbers whether heist similar switches to the robust strength
